stem: Employees repeatedly prop open a door separating intake/quarantine from established production for convenience. What is the best interpretation?
choices: It weakens the intended separation between risk zones and should be corrected through the facility procedure
It improves biosecurity by increasing traffic speed
It has no effect if plants look healthy
It is acceptable whenever humidity is similar on both sides
rationale: Physical and procedural separation only works when boundaries are maintained. Routine bypass can create an avoidable transfer pathway.
